definition: ReRites (also known as RERITES, ReadingRites, Big Data Poetry) is a literary work of "Human + A.I.
details: poetry" by David Jhave Johnston that used neural network models trained to generate poetry which the author then edited. ReRites won the Robert Coover Award for a Work of Electronic Literature in 2022.
story: Imagine a chef tasting every ingredient before it goes into the pot, deciding what belongs and what would ruin the broth. Better ingredients make a better meal, and the same is true here. Every machine is shaped by what it was shown, so someone has to choose that material with care. It is the raw material; the model is only ever as good as what it was fed. And that is ReRites — the unglamorous work everything else stands on.
